en.cta.desc: Make a game, build a tool or explore neural simulation. Infernux is MIT-licensed, with a public roadmap and a community shaping what comes next.
en.cta.title: Bring your world into the forge.

en.footer.tagline: A game engine you write in Python, built toward a Neural Network-Native future. Open source under MIT.
en.hero.subtitle: Python writes the game. C++ runs it. Vulkan and WebGPU draw it. Neural networks are next to join it.
en.home.capabilities.ai.body: Package components, tools and assets as .inxpkg. Runtime and Editor roles keep shipped code separate from authoring services. Add localized panels and menus, or use the optional MCP plugin to automate editor operations.
en.home.capabilities.ai.title: InxPackage plugins and MCP
en.home.capabilities.animation.body: 2D clips and sprite playback, embedded or separate FBX takes, skeletal animation, skinned meshes, state-machine graphs, and Timeline. Matching FBX joints map exactly, with importer pivot helpers handled and incompatible rigs rejected.
en.home.capabilities.animation.title: 2D and 3D animation
en.home.capabilities.asset.body: Project and package assets share GUID identities and live refresh. Player content stays in Content.inxpkg instead of exposing the authoring directory tree. Engine asset APIs resolve paths through the cooked index, with filesystem access for payloads that need it.
en.home.capabilities.asset.title: Assets and project pipeline
en.home.capabilities.data.body: Read and write world properties in batches through NumPy arrays. CPU/GPU JIT and Taichi integration let project scripts run numerical workloads, with target preparation and reusable warmup results.
en.home.capabilities.data.title: World data meets computation
en.home.capabilities.editor.body: Work across Scene/Game views, Hierarchy, Inspector, Project, Console, UI, animation and graph tools. Add your own dockable panels and nested menus while using the shared selection, commands and undo workflow.
en.home.capabilities.editor.title: An editor you can extend
en.home.capabilities.intro: Python gameplay, native rendering and physics, imported content and tools you can extend. The 041 line deepens multi-scene editing, compute, world-space UI and live plugin authoring.
en.home.capabilities.physics.body: Jolt: rigid bodies, colliders, scene queries, collision callbacks and layer filtering, with transforms kept in sync with the scene. Its jobs run on the engine's own thread pool instead of spawning threads of their own.
en.home.capabilities.physics.title: Jolt physics
en.home.capabilities.render.body: Native Players use Vulkan; browser Players use WebGPU. Python defines the RenderStack and C++ runs the render graph. Shared scene and material data feed platform rendering, including lighting, shadows, UI, and particles.
en.home.capabilities.render.title: Vulkan and WebGPU
en.home.capabilities.script.body: Python components, Inspector fields, coroutines and prefabs support everyday gameplay. Transactional reload refreshes project and plugin components, including behavior on existing instances.
en.home.capabilities.script.title: Python gameplay layer
en.home.capabilities.title: From an idea to an interactive world.
en.home.capabilities.vfx.body: GPU Particle Graph: an emitter plus Init, Update and Rendering stages. The typed graph compiles to runtime IR ahead of time, outputs sprites or meshes, and previews live in the editor while you drag its parameters.
en.home.capabilities.vfx.title: Particle Graph on the GPU
en.home.hero.description: Infernux is an open-source game engine you write in Python. Scenes, rendering, physics, compute and editor tools are ready today. Next, it becomes a 3N engine (Neural Network-Native): neural networks that observe, learn and act inside the worlds you build.
en.home.hero.kicker: MIT licensed · open source · written in Python
en.home.hero.platform: Editors: Windows / Linux · Players: Windows / Linux / Android / Web · 0.4.1
en.home.hero.title:
Build worlds.
Give them intelligence.
en.home.system.card1.body: Import content, assemble scenes, tune behavior and export a Player. Rendering, resources, physics and tools work together around the game you are making.
en.home.system.card1.title: 1 · A complete game workflow
en.home.system.card2.body: Use Python for gameplay, editor extensions, render authoring and computation. C++ and the GPU handle the performance-critical runtime work behind those interfaces.
en.home.system.card2.title: 2 · Python authors, C++ executes
en.home.system.card3.body: GUID asset identities, editor commands and transactional reload make changes traceable. The optional MCP plugin lets agents use the editor command and undo paths, with inspectable results.
en.home.system.card3.title: 3 · Every operation is visible
en.home.system.intro: A clear division of work keeps everyday iteration fast and ambitious systems understandable.
en.home.system.title: Built for authors. Open to inspection.
en.home.thesis.card1.body: Scenes, materials, animation, physics, audio and UI turn an idea into a world people want to play. Python lets gameplay and custom tools grow together as the project takes shape.
en.home.thesis.card1.title: Start with a world worth playing
en.home.thesis.card2.body: Batch APIs expose world state to Python, and CPU/GPU JIT with Taichi powers computational gameplay. This is the data path models will use.
en.home.thesis.card2.title: Bring computation into the simulation
en.home.thesis.card3.body: Next: model workflows, portable inference, deterministic replay and batched environments, ending in a model-powered game that ships on the target device.
en.home.thesis.card3.title: Make neural systems part of the game
en.home.thesis.intro: Each stage keeps the game playable while the model side grows. Infernux is building the link from world representation through simulation and tools to deployment.
en.home.thesis.title: A playable world. A learning environment. One engine.
en.tutorials.intro: Start with the five minute path, or open a complete course. Both routes land in the same deterministic engine loop.
en.tutorials.title: Build your way into Infernux.

en.roadmap.galaxy.neural.title: NEURAL NETWORKS & HPC
en.home.world.label: A live pixel-art space battle: white INX ships, each flown by a small neural network, trade pulse fire, flak, rail beams and missiles with a drone swarm near a ringed planet and an orbital dock.
en.home.world.caption: Live browser simulation. Every INX ship reads seven sensor rays and flies with a 16-8-4 policy network: turn, thrust, turn, fire. The panel traces the focused ship.
en.home.n3.title: 3N is a game engine where neural networks are native.
en.home.n3.intro: Most engines treat AI as a plugin, bolted on after the game is finished. A 3N engine is built for models from the first line: the world is data they can read, the simulation is a place where they can act, and the shipped game is somewhere they can run.
en.home.n3.neural.title: Models are part of the cast
en.home.n3.neural.body: A neural network lives in the scene like any component. It observes state, chooses actions, and is debugged in the same editor as your gameplay code.
en.home.n3.network.title: The world speaks in tensors
en.home.n3.network.body: World data moves between simulation and models in batches, without per-object glue code. Many environments step side by side for training and evaluation.
en.home.n3.native.title: Built in, not bolted on
en.home.n3.native.body: Inference, replay and deterministic stepping belong to the runtime itself, and ship with the Player on every target platform.
en.home.reel.title: Real engine footage. No concept art.
en.home.reel.intro: Clips from the Infernux 0.3.4 demo reel. Every frame was rendered live by the engine.
en.home.reel.source: Watch the full reel on Bilibili ↗
en.home.reel.battle: Large-scale gameplay logic driving high-frequency particle bursts
en.home.reel.ocean: FFT ocean simulation with a light post-process
en.home.reel.pipeline: A programmable render pipeline rebuilt at runtime
en.home.reel.coins: 1,000 interacting rigid bodies with a custom cross-star bloom
en.home.reel.cats: A pack of cats driven by animation state machines and Timeline
en.home.reel.rendergraph: RenderGraph sorts passes automatically; split screens compose different effects
en.home.n3.loop.title: THE 3N LOOP · ONE STEP OF A WORLD WITH A MODEL IN IT
en.home.n3.loop.observe.name: Observe
en.home.n3.loop.observe.body: World state leaves the simulation as batched NumPy arrays.
en.home.n3.loop.decide.name: Decide
en.home.n3.loop.decide.body: A model runs inference on those arrays, inside the shipped Player.
en.home.n3.loop.act.name: Act
en.home.n3.loop.act.body: Actions write back to the world through the same batch API.
en.home.n3.loop.step.name: Step
en.home.n3.loop.step.body: The simulation advances deterministically, so any run can be replayed.

zh.footer.tagline: 用 Python 创作的游戏引擎，正驶向神经网络原生的未来。MIT 开源。
zh.hero.subtitle: Python 编写玩法，C++ 驱动运行，Vulkan 与 WebGPU 负责呈现；下一步，让神经网络加入其中。
zh.home.capabilities.ai.body: 将组件、工具与资产打包成 .inxpkg。Runtime 与 Editor 角色明确区分发布代码与创作服务。添加本地化面板和菜单，也可以使用可选 MCP 插件自动化编辑器操作。
zh.home.capabilities.ai.title: InxPackage 插件与 MCP
zh.home.capabilities.animation.body: 2D Clip 与序列帧、FBX 内嵌或独立动画、骨骼动画、蒙皮网格、状态机图与 Timeline。精确映射匹配的 FBX 关节，处理导入器 pivot 辅助节点，并明确拒绝不兼容骨架。
zh.home.capabilities.animation.title: 2D / 3D 动画
zh.home.capabilities.asset.body: 项目和插件资产共用 GUID 身份与实时刷新流程。Player 内容保留在 Content.inxpkg 中，不再展开创作目录树。引擎资产 API 通过构建索引解析路径，需要真实文件的载荷也能获得文件系统访问。
zh.home.capabilities.asset.title: 资产与项目管线
zh.home.capabilities.data.body: 通过 NumPy 数组批量读写世界属性。CPU/GPU JIT 与 Taichi 集成让项目脚本执行数值计算，并结合目标平台准备与可复用预热结果。
zh.home.capabilities.data.title: 世界数据与计算相连
zh.home.capabilities.editor.body: 在 Scene/Game、Hierarchy、Inspector、Project、Console、UI、动画和图工具间协作。添加自己的可停靠面板与多级菜单，沿用统一的选择、命令与撤销流程。
zh.home.capabilities.editor.title: 可以扩展的编辑器
zh.home.capabilities.intro: Python 玩法、原生渲染与物理、导入内容，以及可以随意扩展的工具。041 开发主线进一步打磨多场景编辑、计算、世界空间 UI 与插件实时创作。
zh.home.capabilities.physics.body: Jolt：刚体、碰撞体、场景查询、碰撞回调与层过滤，变换与场景保持同步。它的作业运行在引擎自己的线程池上，而不是另起线程。
zh.home.capabilities.physics.title: Jolt 物理
zh.home.capabilities.render.body: 原生 Player 使用 Vulkan，浏览器 Player 使用 WebGPU。Python 定义 RenderStack，C++ 执行渲染图。共享场景与材质数据用于各平台渲染，覆盖光照、阴影、UI 和粒子。
zh.home.capabilities.render.title: Vulkan 与 WebGPU
zh.home.capabilities.script.body: Python 组件、Inspector 字段、协程与 Prefab 支持日常玩法开发。事务式重载刷新项目和插件组件，包括已有实例的行为。
zh.home.capabilities.script.title: Python 玩法层
zh.home.capabilities.title: 从一个想法，到一个可以交互的世界。
zh.home.capabilities.vfx.body: GPU Particle Graph：一个发射器加 Init / Update / Rendering 三个阶段。类型化的图会提前编译为运行时 IR，可输出 Sprite 或 Mesh，并能在编辑器里边运行边调参。
zh.home.capabilities.vfx.title: 跑在 GPU 上的 Particle Graph
zh.home.hero.description: 熔炉是一款用 Python 创作的开源游戏引擎。场景、渲染、物理、计算与编辑器工具今天就能用；接下来，它将成为 3N（神经网络原生）引擎，让神经网络在你创造的世界里观察、学习与行动。
zh.home.hero.kicker: MIT 开源 · 以 Python 创作
zh.home.hero.platform: 编辑器：Windows / Linux · Player：Windows / Linux / Android / Web · 0.4.1
zh.home.hero.title:
创造世界，
让智能成为其中一部分。
zh.home.system.card1.body: 导入内容、组织场景、调整行为、导出 Player。渲染、资源、物理与工具围绕你正在制作的游戏共同工作。
zh.home.system.card1.title: 1 · 完整的游戏工作流
zh.home.system.card2.body: 用 Python 编写玩法、编辑器扩展、渲染编排和计算，由 C++ 与 GPU 承担接口背后对性能敏感的运行时工作。
zh.home.system.card2.title: 2 · Python 创作，C++ 执行
zh.home.system.card3.body: GUID 资源身份、编辑器命令与事务式重载让修改可追踪。可选 MCP 插件让 Agent 使用编辑器的命令和撤销路径，并检查实际结果。
zh.home.system.card3.title: 3 · 每一步都看得见
zh.home.system.intro: 职责清晰，日常迭代才快；过程可查，复杂系统才可信。
zh.home.system.title: 为创作者打造，也经得起推敲。
zh.home.thesis.card1.body: 场景、材质、动画、物理、音频与 UI，把想法变成值得游玩的世界。随着项目成形，用 Python 让玩法与专属工具一同成长。
zh.home.thesis.card1.title: 先创造值得游玩的世界
zh.home.thesis.card2.body: 批量 API 向 Python 开放世界状态，CPU/GPU JIT 与 Taichi 支撑计算驱动的玩法。这正是模型将来接入世界的数据通道。
zh.home.thesis.card2.title: 让计算参与模拟
zh.home.thesis.card3.body: 下一步：模型工作流、可移植推理、确定性回放与批量环境，最终交付一款在目标设备上运行、由模型驱动的游戏。
zh.home.thesis.card3.title: 让神经系统成为游戏的一部分
zh.home.thesis.intro: 每个阶段都先保证游戏可玩，再让模型能力随之生长。熔炉正在打通从世界表示、模拟、工具到部署的整条链路。
zh.home.thesis.title: 一个可以游玩的世界，也是一个可以学习的环境。

zh.home.world.label: 实时像素风太空战：由小型神经网络驾驶的白色 INX 舰船，在环形行星与轨道船坞附近，以脉冲炮、霰弹、轨道光束和导弹迎战无人机蜂群。
zh.home.world.caption: 浏览器实时模拟。每艘 INX 舰船读取七条感知射线，由 16-8-4 策略网络决定转向、推进与开火。面板实时显示当前聚焦舰船的网络激活。
zh.home.n3.title: 3N：神经网络原生的游戏引擎。
zh.home.n3.intro: 多数引擎把 AI 当作插件，等游戏做完再接上去。3N 引擎从第一行代码起就为模型而设计：世界是它们读得懂的数据，模拟是它们能行动的场所，发布的游戏也是它们能运行的地方。
zh.home.n3.neural.title: 模型是世界的一员
zh.home.n3.neural.body: 神经网络像普通组件一样身处场景：读取状态、做出动作，并与玩法代码在同一个编辑器里调试。
zh.home.n3.network.title: 世界以张量对话
zh.home.n3.network.body: 世界数据以批量形式在模拟与模型之间流动，无需逐对象编写胶水代码；多个环境并行推进，用于训练与评估。
zh.home.n3.native.title: 原生内建，而非外挂
zh.home.n3.native.body: 推理、回放与确定性步进属于运行时本身，并随 Player 一起发布到每个目标平台。
